digest.component_or_area: grounding scan test optimization and real analyzer boundary preservation
propositions: Real analyzer invocations across 31 test nodes consume 234.24 worker-seconds on macOS; immutable fixture reuse experiments show 57.7 seconds (68.4%) savings for combined Python-oracle, coverage, and Engine-B cohorts, but pytest-xdist worker-local fixtures prevent cross-worker reuse without test-boundary or distribution changes.

Tool-present, tool-absent, timeout, invalid-detector, path-quarantine, evidence-normalization, and consumer fail-open/fail-closed behaviors must each retain at least one real invocation for contractual boundary coverage, but call-local YAML validation deduplication within _run_opengrep removes duplicate `semgrep --validate` subprocess calls without relocating test coverage.

No production code or test files were modified and no scanner invocation was removed or mocked; the research remains pending operator approval before implementing cross-test scan-result reuse, fixture-scope promotion, or distribution changes.

Residual gaps exist: exact-defect tests for malformed OpenGrep SARIF, ast-grep JSON, and metric JSON output are missing; CI does not guarantee real analyzer presence across all platforms; and cross-worker result sharing remains architecturally unsolved.
